summary: Reader-journey completeness audit across 8 core topics: identified 33 findings across journey gaps (12), dangling promises (4), dead ends (8), series inconsistencies (9), and 0-source pages (2 critical). Full chain traced per topic with file:line citations.
findings: JOURNEY GAP: High electric bill → no dedicated 'how to lower electric bill' bridge page matching the diagnostic tone of 03-why-is-my-electric-bill-so-high.md. The how-to-lower-electric-bill-complete-guide.md exists but is affiliate-heavy (4 product boxes) and uses a different voice. A reader wanting to go from diagnosis to action finds no mid-funnel page. File: content/blog/03-why-is-my-electric-bill-so-high.md (line 1-10) — mentions 'Next step' links to 01 and electric-bill-breakdown, not to a lowering action guide.

JOURNEY GAP: High water bill → no dedicated 'how to lower water bill' page. 44-how-to-lower-water-bill.md has a misleading slug (says 'lower' but title is 'How to Investigate a High Water Bill') and content is about investigating, not lowering. 06-water-bill-too-high.md is also about investigating. Natural reader query 'how to lower my water bill' has no dedicated page. File: content/blog/44-how-to-lower-water-bill.md (line 4-5, slug vs title mismatch).

JOURNEY GAP: High gas bill → no dedicated 'how to lower gas bill' page. 07-gas-bill-too-high.md (3606 words) embeds fixes within causes, but a reader searching 'lower gas bill' gets no dedicated landing page. The 07 page title is 'Why Is My Gas Bill So High?' — not optimized for lowering intent. File: content/blog/07-gas-bill-too-high.md (line 1-5, title/description).

JOURNEY GAP: Reading bills → no dedicated 'how to read a water bill' page. 44 is mislabeled. 06 is about investigating high bills. The only water bill reading content is in the universal guide how-to-read-your-utility-bill.md (598 words, covers all 3). File: content/blog/44-how-to-lower-water-bill.md (title mismatch).

File: content/blog/05-how-to-lower-utility-bills.md (line 1-5, title/slug mismatch).

risks: 07-gas-bill-too-high.md (3606 words, 0 sources) and 30-sudden-spike-in-electricity-bill-no-usage.md (3543 words, 0 sources) are the site's deepest gas and electric pages respectively — zero external sources means factual claims about furnace efficiency percentages, thermostat savings, HDD calculations, meter error rates, rate change patterns have no citation. Liability risk if a reader acts on unverified numbers.

44-how-to-lower-water-bill.md alias '/blog/stormwater-fee-on-water-bill-explained/' creates a redirect to a page about investigating water bills, not stormwater fees. If this slug was previously a stormwater page, existing backlinks now point to wrong content.
Duplicate content (01/41, 10/fixed-vs-variable, 24/supply-vs-delivery) creates SEO dilution risk. The canonicals on 2 of 3 pairs mitigate this, but 41 has no canonical pointing to 01.
8 stale-year references across 8 pages with no current-year counterpoint erodes trust signals for 2026-date content.

56 of 97 blog articles are under 800 body words — while the AI-bloat trim made some concise, the 300-400 word series pages (04, 08, 10, 11, 13, 17, 18, 19, 20, 21, 22, 24, 25, 26, 27, 41, 44, 45, 46, 47, 48, 49, 50) may be too thin for competitive utility-explainers SERPs.
unknowns: Whether the 44-how-to-lower-water-bill.md alias to stormwater-fee is intentional (slug reuse) or a bug — the alias would redirect someone searching 'stormwater fee' to a water bill investigation page, which is confusing.
Whether the 01/41 duplicate was intentional (01 as detailed guide, 41 as quick reference) but the lack of canonical means both are indexed independently.
Whether the 29-numbering gap was intentional (no page 29) or a deletion that left an alias redirect.
recommendation: Commander: The 8-topic reader journey audit reveals a site with strong individual pages but fragmented topic clusters. Top 3 priorities: (1) Add 2-3 sources each to 07-gas-bill-too-high.md and 30-sudden-spike-in-electricity-bill-no-usage.md — these are the deepest pages with zero citations, a liability risk. (2) Fix the slug/title mismatches on 44-how-to-lower-water-bill.md (rename to 'investigate' or create a real 'lower water bill' page) and 05-how-to-lower-utility-bills.md (align title to slug). (3) Add internal links from the 8 dead-end pages (0 internal links each) to related content — 04-hidden-fees needs links to 17, 18, 19, 22, 24, 25, 49; 08-TOU needs links to 46, 10; 13-ac-short-cycling needs links to ac-running-but-not-cooling, duct-leaks. Recommend retrofitting cross-links in batches rather than page-by-page.
